segments.title: the self as seed basis

spans.tib: nga'o snyam pa tsam gyi blo lhan skyes

segments.note:

The opening Tibetan relation ji ltar ... kyi ltar na is distributed around the people compared; rather than assign the single English According to to one half or absorb supplied those who and the idea of into a broad phrase, both relation markers and the plural/nominal frame are omitted. The first two Tibetan foundation-consciousness compounds select the first two of three English occurrences. GMR repeats the second as this foundation consciousness; the once-at-cursor rule leaves that explanatory repetition unwrapped.

nyon yid supplies only afflicted mind; the thing called is added framing. dmigs pa owns the lexical phrasal verbs focuses on/focus on, while the agentive and English participants remain outside. Within nga'o snyam du, only nga is separately secure as the first me; holds it to be distributes the thought construction and is omitted rather than assigned to snyam or falsely nulled. The single gnas is banked once as place, leaving the repeated verbal stay unwrapped.

The second self-awareness expression is retained whole at phrase depth as simple, natural awareness of yourself; supplied possessive your and the later explanatory and call "me" remain unwrapped. 'dis and its shifted participant our/we are omitted; bzhed owns only say. The base/stain/seed relation is split into exact content words without wrapping the, which is, or with. Exact C16 repetition and the differently translated ILL parallel establish no source correction; no erratum is proposed.
